title: 研究人员用 GPT-5.6 Sol 发现 PHP 两个 CVSS 9.2 严重漏洞
content:
Rohan Paul· @rohanpaul_ai · X·· 58 分钟前精选AI 评分78
AI 导读
AI 安全公司 Calif 用 GPT-5.6 Sol 在 PHP 中发现两个 CVSS 9.2 严重漏洞，可让无账号攻击者接管 Web 服务器，影响远至 PHP 5.4 的版本，PHP 提前一天紧急发布修复。
推荐理由
原文梳理了 AI 发现 PHP 严重漏洞的细节与修复过程，并附上可复用的 PHP 版本检查 Codex skill 入口。
正文 · AI 翻译
使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 的研究人员在 PHP 中发现了一个极其严重的漏洞，PHP 驱动着约 70% 的网站，该漏洞导致主要网站下线，运营方纷纷紧急修补。
发现该漏洞的 AI 安全公司 Calif 在一份声明中表示，如果不尽快修补，这些漏洞可能使全球 70% 的网站面临风险，并称其为“AI 发现的最严重漏洞，甚至可能是整个软件史上最严重的漏洞”。
PHP 紧急发布了修复程序，因为这些漏洞可能让无账号的攻击者接管 Web 服务器。
两个漏洞在 CVSS 严重性评分中均为 9.2 分，影响低至 5.4 的 PHP 版本。
当请求在错误的时机触及 PHP 的内存上限时，PHP 会释放内存但保留指向该内存的指针，该工作进程上后续的请求便可劫持这块内存。
审计人员在 2024 年发现了这一弱点，但修复工作停滞了数月，部分原因是没有人展示过实际攻击。
现由 Google 拥有的云安全公司 Wiz 表示，这些模型让一名研究人员在一周内完成了过去顶尖团队需要数月才能完成的工作。
CVE 编号的泄露迫使 PHP 提前一天发布，Cloudflare 目前报告称已出现早期攻击尝试。
来源：Rohan Paul · x.com

report.summary: AI security firm Calif used GPT-5.6 Sol to uncover two CVSS 9.2 PHP vulnerabilities allowing unauthenticated server takeover, forcing an emergency patch affecting versions back to 5.4.
report.background: PHP underpins roughly 70% of the web, including WordPress, Drupal, and countless custom backends, so memory-safety flaws in its interpreter are among the highest-leverage bugs in software. The underlying weakness — a use-after-free triggered when a request hits PHP's memory limit, leaving a dangling pointer that other requests on the same worker can hijack — was spotted by human auditors back in 2024, but remediation stalled for months largely because nobody produced a working exploit to justify urgency. That changed as large language models grew capable of reading code at scale and reasoning about lifetime and state across a codebase. The find fits a broader 2025-2026 wave of AI-driven vulnerability discovery, following Google's Big Sleep and OSS-Fuzz work and DARPA's AIxCC, where models are pointed at mature open-source code that humans have audited for decades. Disclosure pressure and a leaked CVE identifier accelerated the timeline.
key_points: Two distinct flaws both score 9.2 on CVSS, and the researchers say unauthenticated attackers can chain them to seize control of a web server — no login, no credentials, no user interaction required. Patched versions extend as far back as PHP 5.4, meaning very old, long-unsupported deployments are also exposed.

The root cause is a memory-limit edge case: when a request hits PHP's memory ceiling at the wrong moment, the interpreter frees a block but keeps a pointer to it. A later request handled by the same worker process can then claim that memory and hijack execution.

Human auditors identified the weakness in 2024, but the fix languished because no one demonstrated a real attack. The AI-generated proof of concept converted a theoretical concern into an emergency, showing that exploitability evidence — not just detection — is what moves maintainers.

Speed is the headline. Wiz, now owned by Google, says the models let a single researcher accomplish in one week what elite teams previously needed months to do, shifting vulnerability research from a staffing problem into a tooling problem.

The CVE identifier leaked before the coordinated release date, forcing PHP to ship its patch a day early. Cloudflare already reports early exploitation attempts in the wild, so administrators who delay patching are now in the blast radius.
report.impact: For the AI industry, this is a credibility milestone: LLM-driven code reasoning moved from benchmark demos to finding a top-severity flaw in software that runs most of the internet, strengthening the case for AI in defensive security budgets. For developers, it compresses patch windows dramatically — a flaw that sat idle for two years went from exploit to emergency release in days, and maintainers now face AI-speed disclosure pressure. For regular users, the practical risk is concentrated in neglected infrastructure: shared hosting, legacy CMS installs, and forgotten PHP 5.x boxes that will never be updated. The broader consequence is a coming surge of AI-found vulnerabilities across mature open-source projects, which will strain maintainer capacity and could push the industry toward faster, more automated patch pipelines.
report.tools: Check your stack with a plain `php -v` or a packaged Codex skill that audits PHP versions across hosts. For defenders wanting to replicate the workflow, look at Google's Big Sleep and OSS-Fuzz AI tooling, DARPA AIxCC's open-sourced Cyber Reasoning Systems (Team Atlanta, Trail of Bits Buttercup), plus Semgrep and CodeQL for static analysis and Nuclei templates for verification. Wiz's research blog and Cloudflare's vulnerability advisories are the fastest places to track exploitation in the wild.
